b2-venezuelapetroleo-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Valley of Caracas
b2-venezuelapetroleo-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about Caracas, and he asks where the city was founded.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-01.prompt: Tell Carlos where Caracas was founded, putting the place first.
cues: Put the place at the start of the sentence
Say that the city was founded there
b2-venezuelapetroleo-01.target: En un valle estrecho fue fundada Caracas en 1567.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-01.english: Caracas was founded in 1567 in a narrow valley.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-01.canDo: I can put a place or a quality first for emphasis, as in *En un valle estrecho fue fundada Caracas*.

b2-venezuelapetroleo-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Oil
b2-venezuelapetroleo-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You have read an article about the first oil wells, and Meg asks what Venezuela lived from before oil.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-02.prompt: Tell Meg what Venezuela lived from before oil was discovered.
cues: Say what the country lived from
b2-venezuelapetroleo-02.target: Antes de que se descubriera el petróleo, Venezuela vivía del café y del cacao.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-02.english: Before oil was discovered, Venezuela lived from coffee and cacao.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-02.canDo: I can say what was true before something happened with *antes de que* and the subjunctive.

b2-venezuelapetroleo-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Clouds in the Aula Magna
b2-venezuelapetroleo-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are looking at photographs of the Ciudad Universitaria in Caracas, and he asks about the Calder panels.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what the Calder panels look like.
cues: Say that they hang from the ceiling
b2-venezuelapetroleo-03.target: Las Nubes de Calder cuelgan del techo como si fueran nubes de verdad.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-03.english: Calder's Clouds hang from the ceiling as if they were real clouds.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-03.canDo: I can make a comparison with something unreal using *como si* and the imperfect subjunctive.

b2-venezuelapetroleo-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Was Soto Born
b2-venezuelapetroleo-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos says that Jesús Soto was born in Caracas, but the article you read says something else.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-04.prompt: Correct Carlos politely, with a stance adverb.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-04.target: En realidad, Soto nació en Ciudad Bolívar, no en Caracas.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-04.english: Actually, Soto was born in Ciudad Bolívar, not in Caracas.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-04.canDo: I can show my attitude to a fact with stance adverbs such as *en realidad* and *lamentablemente*.

b2-venezuelapetroleo-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Country Should Have Done
b2-venezuelapetroleo-05.scenario: You are Carlos. You are telling Meg what economists say about the years of high oil prices.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-05.prompt: Tell Meg what several economists say the country should have done.
cues: Say what the country should have done
b2-venezuelapetroleo-05.target: Según varios economistas, el país debería haber ahorrado más en los años de precios altos.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-05.english: According to several economists, the country should have saved more in the years of high prices.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-05.canDo: I can say what should have been done with *debería haber* + past participle.

b2-venezuelapetroleo-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Short Summary
b2-venezuelapetroleo-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You are telling Carlos what you remember about the Ciudad Universitaria.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-consolidation.prompt: Say what UNESCO decided in 2000, and compare the campus to something.
cues: Compare the campus to a city
b2-venezuelapetroleo-consolidation.target: En 2000 la UNESCO declaró la Ciudad Universitaria Patrimonio de la Humanidad. Parece una ciudad pequeña, como si tuviera sus propias calles.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-consolidation.english: In 2000 UNESCO declared the Ciudad Universitaria a World Heritage site. It looks like a small city, as if it had its own streets.
b2-venezuelapetroleo-consolidation.canDo: I can put a place or a quality first for emphasis.
